QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] The Ryuul's Greeting
QuestInfo.0: The Ryuul alien, Surana, is Eremos's disciple. Talk to her to learn more about her.
QuestInfo.1: Surana acts as Eremose's disciple. It is her responsibility to help maintain their spaceship, the Eluna Express. This marvelous ship is capable of transporting you anywhere in Maple World, and Surana says they have come to help the heroes in Maple World level up.
